title: Shyam Premi SN
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm festive colours, glowing diyas, vertical friendly centred composition, no text, no letters, no writing
endline: Apne parivaar ko bhejein 🙏 | Subscribe: Shyam Premi SN

scenes.prompt: A smiling young Indian sister in a festive saree applying a red tilak on her brother's forehead, an aarti thali with a lit diya, rice, roli and sweets in her hand, a decorated home with marigold garlands and diyas, warm loving family mood
scenes.animate: the diya flame on the thali flickers softly, a gentle warm glow and the camera slowly pushes in; the faces stay still
scenes.line: भाई-बहन का प्यार सदा बना रहे
scenes.tts: शुभ भाई दूज! भाई बहन का यह प्यार सदा बना रहे।
scenes.sub: Shubh Bhai Dooj! Bhai behen ka yeh pyaar sada bana rahe.

scenes.prompt: The calm Yamuna river at golden sunset with small leaf boats carrying lit diyas floating on the water, ghats with marigold flowers, peaceful devotional mood
scenes.animate: the diyas float slowly on the gently rippling water and the flames flicker softly
scenes.line: यमुना जी और यमराज जी के स्नेह का पर्व
scenes.tts: यह पर्व यमुना जी और उनके भाई यमराज जी के स्नेह की याद दिलाता है।
scenes.sub: Yeh parv Yamuna ji aur unke bhai Yamraj ji ke sneh ki yaad dilata hai.

scenes.prompt: A decorated Bhai Dooj aarti thali with a lit diya, roli, rice, a coconut and Indian sweets on a festive red cloth, marigold petals around, soft golden bokeh
scenes.line: हर भाई-बहन की जोड़ी खुश रहे
scenes.tts: हर भाई बहन की जोड़ी हमेशा खुश रहे। भाई दूज की शुभकामनाएँ।
scenes.sub: Har bhai behen ki jodi hamesha khush rahe. Bhai Dooj ki shubhkamnayein.

scenes.tts: अपने परिवार को भेजें। जय श्री श्याम!
scenes.sub: Apne parivaar ko bhejein. Subscribe: Shyam Premi SN. Jai Shree Shyam!
